notes_for_editor: Identity is the weak link. The West Lookouts list files the 100-foot tower under 'J. CLARK SAYLER WILDLIFE REFUGE (UPPER SOURIS)' with no HQ label. The HQ match rests on the Forest Fire Lookout Association row 'Upper Souris NWR – HQ' at 48.46032, -101.57283 plus the Upper Souris label. Treat as probable, not confirmed. The same list moved a different J. Clark Salyer HQ tower to Rugby in 1992; that is not this tower. Lead, not cited: HAER survey photos on loc.gov (hhh.nd0028, hhh.nd0033) describe a lookout tower at the refuge headquarters, but loc.gov returned 403 to fetch_text. Not found in any page read: reason for construction, staffing, notable fires, current public access, rentals. The FWS visit-location page in the cache has no directions. Brief record had no height; 30.5 m is 100 ft converted. Verification 2026-10-09: the story no longer says the tower was erected 'at the site' or that it 'stands at its headquarters'; the HQ link is stated as unconfirmed. 'And rest' was dropped from the founding sentence (the Wikipedia text says breeding ground only).
